# sigma_member (Data Source)

Retrieves a Sigma member by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_member" "example" {
  id = "member-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Member ID.

### Read-Only

- `email` (String) Email address.
- `first_name` (String) First name.
- `home_folder_id` (String) ID of the member's My Documents folder.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Whether deactivated.
- `is_inactive` (Boolean) Whether inactive through SCIM.
- `last_name` (String) Last name.
- `member_type` (String) Account type.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID.
- `user_kind` (String) User kind.
